text:
Aisha: Heads up 026 perf cycle timeline: manager ACKs required by Tue 05/20 EOD. Review window opens 05/25 and closes 06/05. Please confirm in thread.
Luis: link to the packet?
Aisha: Uploaded to Drive: /drive/PeopleOps/2026_Perf/Manager_Packet_FINAL.pdf and Review_Form_Final.docx
Priya: is there a condensed checklist managers can forward to their leads? want to make it easy.
Aisha: yes 0 one-pager checklist in the packet. TL;DR: complete Review_Form_Final, attach 2-4 evidence items (PR links, design comps, customer notes) with dates, note promo context separately, and indicate suggested calibration band with 2-line rationale.
Tom: we have 2 managers on parental leave during the window. Whats the interim reviewer rule?
Aisha: interim reviewer flow is on p.3 of the packet: if manager out >48h, assign interim (skip-level or peer manager) who uses the evidence repo to compile review. Notify people-ops@redwood with "Interim Reviewer Assigned" in subject.
Luis: can we standardize the interim note text? calibration board likes uniform phrasing.
Aisha: yes 0 use: "Interim reviewer statement: Manager on approved leave; review compiled from PRs, tickets, and peer feedback (dates MM/DD0-MM/DD). Recommended band: X. Sources: <list>." Please copy verbatim.
Priya: any tweaks to rating definitions this year?
Aisha: minor clarifications: "Meets" now includes consistent delivery of expected impact on roadmap items. Full definitions on p.4 with role-specific examples (Eng/Product/Design/Support).
HR-bot: Reminder: All non-intern IC reviews must use Review_Form_Final.docx. Missing forms trigger automated reminders 72h and 24h prior to close.
Tom: are calibration decks required or optional? last time some teams brought slides, others did not.
Aisha: optional. If you use a deck, upload to the same folder named like teamname_calib_v1.pdf. If you don't submit a deck, we still need the form and evidence attachments.
Luis: can people-ops publish a daily missing-items report? that'll help managers chase.
Aisha: yes 0 we'll post a daily repo at 9:00am starting 05/23 listing missing forms and missing evidence attachments, and DM managers.
Priya: escalation if IC disputes final bucket after calibration?
Aisha: escalation path: 1) submit dispute form w/in 5 business days; 2) People Ops reviews w/ calibration chairs; 3) final decision by Head of People. Dispute form link in packet.
Tom: scheduling note: can we get 30-min manager drop-in Q&A sessions next week? some new managers have questions about evidence quality.
Aisha: scheduled two slots: Tue 05/18 10:00-10:30 and Wed 05/19 16:00-16:30 (Zoom link in packet). Recordings will be available.
Luis: small ask 0 please remind managers to separate promotion context from performance feedback. Promotions follow a different cadence and need a separate doc.
Aisha: added a "Promotion Context" section in the form and linked the Promotions_SOP.pdf.
HR-bot: Note: Interns and contractors use a simplified form (Review_Form_Short.docx).
Priya: ACK from me. I'll block time with my managers to complete.
Tom: ACK.
Luis: ACK.
